name: Alice Wisteria
original_name: アリス・ウィステリア
source:
Princess of the Kingdom of Wisteria. A girl possessed by the plant fairy Leaf. Her power as a fairy possessor is weakened.

She is the captain of the subjugation unit in the Knights, and she excels in martial arts. She has a cheerful, serious, and obedient personality.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/midorino_himegimi.html#chara]official website[/url]]
